summary: Lake County, MT tower site dated 1973 and listed gone; on the Flathead Indian Reservation, six miles east of Ronan. No construction, staffing or fire history found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by firelookout.com and the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date given

access.note: Page places the site on the Flathead Indian Reservation; no source states an access rule or whether visitors may go up, so no permission level is recorded

events.note: Page reads '1973: tower. Gone.' and does not say whether 1973 is the build year

evidence.supports: dated 1973 as a tower and marked gone
page title Crow Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower
listed as Crow Mtn. in the Flathead-Swan River region list

sources.title: Flathead-Swan River Region Montana Forest Fire Lookout Tower Sites

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two catalog entries and one regional list. The 1973 date reads as '1973: tower. Gone.' and is kept as an event of type other because the page does not say whether it is a build year. Reservation land status alone is not a stated access rule, so the access level is set to unknown. The Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes lookout page lists Jocko, Pistol Creek and Irvine in Lake County but no Crow Mountain in the text fetched. Two WebSearch queries found no history. Consider a DNRC or tribal records check before upgrading confidence. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story no longer asks readers to seek tribal permission; it only advises checking with the tribal authorities.
